lin_land_girl.text: Lincolnshire grew the potatoes and the sugar beet, and sent the sausages. Half the country's food came off these flat fields.
There's a whole street of old shops in here: a chemist, a saddler, a wheelwright. Smells of polish and string.

lin_curator.text: That big iron box in the hall is a First World War tank, built in Lincoln. Fosters made agricultural machinery: traction engines, threshers. Then they made the first tanks.

then.text: How's your Treadlet? Still flattening hedges?

else.text: And look what's turned up rattling round the yard. A Treadlet! Little Willie's spirit, I reckon. It wants to see the world. Take it.
